IKEA and Sabine Marcelis introduce VARMBLIXT - IKEA
Linling Lu’s Soundwaves is the Phillips’s 2023 Spring Intersections project | The Phillips Collection
Art Basel Miami 2023: EBONY FWD & Coca-Cola Zero Sugar
Artist lineup set for ‘Made in L.A. 2023’ at Hammer Museum | UCLA

content.text:
Here are some **notable art/design collaborations from 2023** across fashion, luxury, interiors, tech, and exhibitions:

| Collaboration | Type | Why it stood out |
|---|---|---|
| **Louis Vuitton x Yayoi Kusama** | Luxury fashion / contemporary art | One of 2023’s biggest art-fashion crossovers, reviving LV’s earlier Kusama partnership with polka-dot bags, ready-to-wear, accessories, and major store installations. ([fashionista.com](https://fashionista.com/2023/01/louis-vuitton-yayoi-kusama-collaboration-collection-prices-2023?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Hublot x Takashi Murakami** | Watches / NFTs / contemporary art | Hublot and Murakami launched **13 unique watches and 13 NFTs** featuring Murakami’s iconic smiling flower motif. ([hublot.com](https://www.hublot.com/en-us/news/hublot-murakami-13-unique-watches-and-nfts?utm_source=openai)) |
| **IKEA x Sabine Marcelis — VARMBLIXT** | Product design / interiors | A 20-piece collection centered on sculptural lighting, home objects, rugs, and glassware; the orange “donut” lamp became especially recognizable. ([ikea.com](https://www.ikea.com/us/en/newsroom/range-news/ikea-and-sabine-marcelis-launch-the-varmblixt-collection-exploring-the-power-of-sculptural-design-and-light-pubac5f3b70/?utm_source=openai)) |
| **PhotoVogue x Voice — 2023 Digital Art Collection** | Digital art / Web3 | A residency-style digital art collaboration featuring 22 artists from the PhotoVogue community, focused on representation and NFT-based releases. ([vogue.com](https://www.vogue.com/article/2023-photovogue-digital-art-collection-voice?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Linling Lu x The Phillips Collection — *Soundwaves*** | Museum / visual art / music | Lu created a visual response to Philip Glass’s *Etude no. 16*, translating sound into concentric abstract paintings for the Phillips Collection’s 2023 Intersections series. ([phillipscollection.org](https://www.phillipscollection.org/press/linling-lus-soundwaves-phillipss-2023-spring-intersections-project?utm_source=openai)) |
| **EBONY FWD x Coca-Cola Zero Sugar at Art Basel Miami 2023** | Brand / art fair / immersive exhibition | Presented work by 11 artists in an immersive Art Basel Miami event combining visual art, music, food, and digital/physical installation. ([ebony.com](https://www.ebony.com/coca-cola-zero-sugar-art-basel-2023/?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Hammer Museum — *Made in L.A. 2023: Acts of Living*** | Artist collective / biennial exhibition | Not a brand collab, but a major collaborative exhibition context featuring LA-based artists and collectives exploring community, daily life, queer histories, and diasporic/Indigenous narratives. ([newsroom.ucla.edu](https://newsroom.ucla.edu/releases/artist-lineup-made-in-la-2023-hammer-museum?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Helsinki Biennial 2023 AI art-curation project** | AI / museum collection / public space | Researchers used AI to reimagine Helsinki Art Museum works placed across the city as synthetic 360-degree panoramas, blurring curation, urban space, and machine perception. ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.03753?utm_source=openai)) |

If you mean **fashion-brand art collaborations specifically**, the biggest 2023 names were probably **Louis Vuitton x Yayoi Kusama**, **Hublot x Takashi Murakami**, and **IKEA x Sabine Marcelis** in the broader design-art space.
